title: Do as I Do: Dexterous Manipulation Data from Everyday Human Videos
summary: How can we scalably generate data for robotic manipulation, especially on human-like platforms such as dexterous multi-fingered hands? Learning from human videos has recently emerged as a likely answer to this question. However, difficulties in estimating hand-object interaction and crossing the human-to-robot embodiment gap have hindered the adoption of abundant monocular RGB-only human videos as the primary source of robot manipulation data. In this work, we present DO AS I DO, an algorithm to reconstruct and retarget monocular RGB human videos to multi-fingered dexterous robotic hands. DO AS I DO reconstructs hand-object interactions from various egocentric and exocentric in-the-wild video sources. The algorithm then retargets these hand-object interaction estimates into a sequence of actions executable in the real world, yielding robot-complete manipulation data from disparate human videos. Overall, DO AS I DO outperforms previous state of the art in estimating hand-object interactions and extracting dexterous manipulation trajectories from RGB videos, as we show in experiments on datasets with ground truths and on a dataset of video clips collected online. Our experiments enable us to propose an efficacy playbook for practitioners collecting human data for manipulation.
tldr: This work presents an algorithm that reconstructs hand-object interactions from monocular RGB human videos and retargets them into executable actions for dexterous robotic hands, enabling scalable data generation for robotic manipulation from everyday human videos.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种算法，从单目RGB人类视频中重建手-物交互，并将其重定向为灵巧机器人手可执行的动作，从而利用日常人类视频规模化生成机器人操作数据。
summary_zh: 如何实现机器人操作数据的可扩展生成，尤其是针对类人平台（如灵巧多指手）？从人类视频中学习近来成为解决该问题的潜在方案。然而，手-物交互估计的困难以及人-机器人形态差异的跨越障碍，限制了将丰富的单目RGB纯人类视频作为机器人操作数据主要来源的可行性。本研究提出"照我做"算法，用于将单目RGB人类视频重建并重定向至多指灵巧机器人手。该算法能从多种自我中心与非自我中心的野外视频源中重建手-物交互，随后将这些交互估计重定向为真实世界可执行的动作序列，从而从不同人类视频中生成完整的机器人操作数据。总体而言，在包含真实标注的数据集及在线收集的视频片段数据集上的实验表明，"照我做"算法在手-物交互估计与从RGB视频提取灵巧操作轨迹方面均超越了现有最优方法。基于实验结果，我们为从业者收集人类操作数据提出了有效性操作指南。

title: Mem-World: Memory-Augmented Action-Conditioned World Models for Persistent Robot Manipulation
summary: Action-conditioned world models have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot learning, offering a scalable alternative to costly real-world experimentation by generating action-consistent video rollouts. However, persistent world modeling remains challenging in manipulation: frequent end-effector occlusions and rapid wrist-camera motion make the current observation insufficient for predicting future views, causing models to forget or hallucinate scene details seen in earlier frames. Existing memory retrieval strategies often fail to identify informative history in dynamic manipulation scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose Mem-World, a memory-augmented multi-view action-conditioned world model. At its core, we present W-VMem, a 4D wrist-view-centered surfel-indexed memory that anchors historical observations to temporally evolving surface elements. By explicitly modeling when and where scene elements are observed, W-VMem enables geometry-aware retrieval of relevant history frames conditioned on future actions. During generation, relevant history frames are selected via surfel-based rendering and scoring, providing informative and non-redundant context for prediction. Extensive experiments show that Mem-World generates persistent rollouts in complex manipulation scenarios, enables more reliable policy evaluation than Ctrl-World, improving the Pearson correlation with real-world performance by 14.5\%, and supports effective policy improvement through synthetic data generation, increasing success rates from 58\% to 72\% on long-horizon tasks.
tldr: Mem-World proposes a memory-augmented action-conditioned world model with a 4D wrist-view-centered surfel-indexed memory to handle occlusions and camera motion, improving rollout persistence and policy evaluation in robot manipulation.
tldr_zh: Mem-World提出了一种带有4D腕部视角中心曲面索引记忆的记忆增强动作条件世界模型，以应对遮挡和相机运动，提高了机器人操作中的推演持久性和策略评估。
summary_zh: 动作条件世界模型已成为机器人学习的一种有前景的范式，通过生成动作一致的视频推演，为昂贵的真实世界实验提供了可扩展的替代方案。然而，在操作任务中，持续的世界建模仍面临挑战：频繁的末端执行器遮挡和快速的腕部相机运动使得当前观测不足以预测未来视图，导致模型遗忘或虚构早期帧中出现的场景细节。现有记忆检索策略往往无法在动态操作场景中识别有效历史信息。为解决这一局限，我们提出Mem-World——一种记忆增强的多视图动作条件世界模型。其核心是W-VMem，一种以腕部相机视图为中心的4D surfel索引记忆，将历史观测锚定到随时间演变的表面元素上。通过显式建模场景元素被观测的时间与位置，W-VMem能够基于未来动作实现几何感知的相关历史帧检索。在生成过程中，通过基于surfel的渲染与评分选择相关历史帧，为预测提供信息丰富且无冗余的上下文。大量实验表明，Mem-World能在复杂操作场景中生成持续推演，相较于Ctrl-World实现更可靠的策略评估，与真实世界性能的皮尔逊相关系数提升14.5%，并通过合成数据生成支持有效的策略改进，在长时域任务中将成功率从58%提升至72%。

title: Object-Centric Residual RL for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real VLA Enhancement
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can generalize across diverse manipulation tasks, but their imitation-learning-based policies remain brittle in precise physical interactions due to compounding execution errors; Can a reinforcement learning policy trained purely in simulation improve the robustness of real-world VLAs zero-shot? Residual RL, which learns a corrective policy on top of a frozen VLA, offers a natural framework, but existing approaches face a fundamental sim-to-real dilemma: privileged-state methods require lossy distillation for deployment; image-based methods suffer from the visual domain gap; and real-world RL is costly and unsafe. We propose an object-centric residual RL framework that refines VLA actions using object poses, enabling a compact observation space that transfers consistently between simulation and reality. To align the two domains, we additionally replay the same teleoperation demonstrations in simulation to train a sim counterpart of the real-world VLA. The residual RL policy is trained only in simulation with pose noise injection and dropout, and transfers zero-shot to the real robot. Across five manipulation tasks on a real Franka Research 3 (FR3) robot, our method improves the success rate from 42% to 76% zero-shot, and the improved rollouts can be further reused to retrain the base VLA for self-improvement without additional teleoperation. Project page: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/articles/object-centric-residual-rl/
tldr: Proposes an object-centric residual RL framework that refines VLA policies using object poses, trained purely in simulation with domain randomization, achieving zero-shot sim-to-real transfer and improving success rates from 42% to 76% on real-world manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出一种以物体为中心的残差强化学习框架，利用物体姿态精炼VLA策略，仅通过域随机化在仿真中训练，实现零样本仿真到现实的迁移，将实际操作的位姿成功率从42%提升至76%。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够泛化到多种操作任务中，但基于模仿学习的策略在精确物理交互中仍因累积执行误差而表现脆弱；仅通过仿真训练的强化学习策略能否零样本提升实际VLA模型的鲁棒性？残差强化学习在冻结VLA模型之上学习修正策略，提供了自然框架，但现有方法面临根本的仿真-现实困境：特权状态方法需要有损蒸馏才能部署；基于图像的方法受视觉域差异影响；而现实世界的强化学习成本高昂且不安全。我们提出一种以物体为中心的残差强化学习框架，利用物体位姿优化VLA动作，从而实现紧凑的观测空间，使其在仿真与现实之间保持一致性。为实现两个域的对齐，我们还在仿真中回放相同的遥操作演示，以训练真实世界VLA的仿真对应模型。残差强化学习策略仅通过位姿噪声注入和丢弃法在仿真中训练，并零样本迁移至真实机器人。在实际Franka Research 3（FR3）机器人的五项操作任务中，我们的方法将成功率从42%提升至76%（零样本），且改进后的执行轨迹可进一步用于重新训练基础VLA模型，实现无需额外遥操作的自我提升。项目页面：https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/articles/object-centric-residual-rl/

title: HALOMI: Learning Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Active Perception from Human Demonstrations
summary: Human demonstrations, which can be collected at scale and naturally capture active hand-eye coordination, are a promising data source for learning humanoid loco-manipulation. However, directly transferring human demonstrations to humanoids requires a precise world-frame tracking controller, which is often brittle under Out-of-Distribution(OOD) targets, while human-to-humanoid gaps persist in both egocentric observation and action execution. To address these challenges, we present HALOMI, a scalable framework for learning humanoid loco-manipulation with active perception from human demonstrations. HALOMI extends Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) with egocentric sensing to collect ego-view and wrist-view observations along with head-hand trajectories at scale. We further propose a manifold-constrained controller that plans in a learned latent behavior manifold to enable precise and robust head-hand tracking in the world frame. To bridge the human-to-humanoid gap, we perform ego-view alignment and introduce a controller-aware reference trajectory adaptation to reduce mismatch in both observation and action execution. We validate HALOMI on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot with an actuated neck across five real-world tasks involving navigation, grasping, bimanual manipulation, whole-body coordination, and dynamic behaviors. Across the three quantitatively evaluated tasks, HALOMI achieves an average success rate of 85\%, while additional qualitative demonstrations show its ability to support dynamic tossing and deep-squat grasping.
tldr: A framework for learning humanoid loco-manipulation from human demonstrations, combining egocentric sensing with a manifold-constrained controller and observation-action adaptation to bridge the human-to-humanoid gap.
tldr_zh: 一个从人类演示中学习人形机器人全身操控的框架，结合自我中心感知、流形约束控制器以及观察-动作适应，弥合人与机器人之间的差距。
summary_zh:
摘要：
人类示教数据可大规模收集，并能自然捕捉主动的手眼协调行为，是学习人形机器人全身操控（loco-manipulation）的理想数据源。然而，将人类示教直接迁移至人形机器人需要精确的世界坐标系跟踪控制器，该控制器在面临分布外目标时通常较为脆弱，且人类与人形机器人在自我中心观测与动作执行层面均存在固有差异。为解决这些挑战，我们提出HALOMI——一种基于人类示教学习人形机器人主动感知全身操控的可扩展框架。HALOMI通过扩展通用操控接口（UMI）并集成自我中心感知，能够大规模采集自我视角与手腕视角的观测数据，以及头部-手部联合轨迹。我们进一步提出了一种流形约束控制器，该控制器在学习的潜在行为流形中进行规划，以实现世界坐标系下精确鲁棒的头部-手部跟踪。为弥合人类与人形机器人间的差距，我们执行自我视角对齐，并引入一种感知控制器的参考轨迹自适应机制，以减少观测与动作执行中的不匹配。我们在配备可驱动颈部的Unitree G1人形机器人上，对包含导航、抓取、双臂操控、全身协调及动态行为的五项真实世界任务进行了验证。在三个量化评估任务中，HALOMI实现了85%的平均成功率，而额外的定性演示表明其具备支持动态抛掷与深蹲抓取的能力。

title: Guava: An Effective and Universal Harness for Embodied Manipulation
summary: Language models trained on large-scale vision-language data have demonstrated strong potential for embodied agents. Harnessing models through embodied tools use offers a promising alternative to end-to-end vision-language-action systems by combining high-level reasoning with external modules for perception, planning, and control. However, it remains unclear what makes an effective harness for embodied manipulation, and to what extent such a harness can unlock embodied capabilities in a wide range of reasoning models. In this work, we present Guava, a harness framework for embodied tool use developed through systematic exploration of the design space of agent workflows, action spaces, and observation spaces. Our study identifies three key ingredients for effective embodied agents: iterative perception-reasoning-action loops, semantic action abstractions, and multimodal observations. To understand whether these design principles are universal even to small models, we develop an end-to-end training pipeline that distills embodied manipulation capabilities into a 4B open-source model using fewer than 2K trajectories collected entirely in simulation. Experimental results in both simulation and real-world environments show performance comparable to frontier proprietary models while exhibiting strong generalization to unseen objects, novel instructions, and long-horizon tasks. Results suggest that a well-designed harness can serve as a scalable, model-agnostic interface for embodied manipulation, enabling strong emergent embodied capabilities in compact open-source models with minimal training data.
tldr: Guava is a harness framework for embodied tool use that identifies iterative perception-reasoning-action loops, semantic action abstractions, and multimodal observations as key ingredients, and distills manipulation capabilities into a 4B model using under 2K simulated trajectories, achieving performance comparable to frontier proprietary models.
tldr_zh: Guava 是一个面向具身工具使用的框架，通过识别迭代感知-推理-行动循环、语义行动抽象和多模态观察三个关键要素，利用少于 2000 条模拟轨迹将操作能力蒸馏到 4B 模型中，性能可与前沿专有模型媲美。
summary_zh: 在大规模视觉-语言数据上训练的语言模型已展现出应用于具身智能体的巨大潜力。通过具身工具使用来驾驭模型，为端到端的视觉-语言-动作系统提供了一种有前景的替代方案，其将高层推理与用于感知、规划和控制的外部模块相结合。然而，对于何种因素能有效驾驭具身操作，以及这种驾驭能在多大程度上解锁各类推理模型的具身能力，目前尚不明确。在本工作中，我们提出Guava，这是一个通过系统性探索智能体工作流、动作空间与观测空间设计空间而开发的具身工具使用驾驭框架。我们的研究识别出有效具身智能体的三个关键要素：迭代式感知-推理-动作循环、语义化动作抽象以及多模态观测。为探究这些设计原则是否对小模型也具有普适性，我们开发了一条端到端训练流水线，利用完全在仿真环境中采集的不足2000条轨迹，将具身操作能力蒸馏至一个40亿参数的开源模型中。在仿真与真实环境中的实验结果表明，该模型性能可与前沿专有模型相媲美，同时对未见物体、新指令及长周期任务展现出强大的泛化能力。研究结果提示：一个精心设计的驾驭框架可作为具身操作的可扩展、模型无关的接口，使紧凑型开源模型仅凭极少的训练数据即可涌现出强大的具身能力。

title: Zero-Shot Long-Horizon Dexterous Manipulation via Multi-View 3D-Grounded VLM Reasoning
summary: We present a zero-shot framework for long-horizon dexterous manipulation that grounds language instructions into executable 3D task plans from calibrated multi-view RGB images. Rather than training an end-to-end policy, our system uses a vision-language model (VLM) to produce reference-frame task grounding and primitive-level 2D keypoints, then lifts them into 3D via multi-view fusion. This lifting combines triangulation of view-wise VLM groundings with reference-view ray voting, which searches along a semantic camera ray for geometrically consistent candidates across neighboring views. The resulting 3D keypoints support both pick-and-place and tool-use: for tool-use, we retrieve an object-centric atomic action corresponding to the inferred skill category and align its stored 6D tool trajectory to the scene; for dexterous execution, we expand the lifted grasp keypoint into a task-conditioned grasp affordance region and generate feasible grasp-motion pairs with an arm-hand motion generator. Real-world experiments show improved 3D grounding accuracy and execution reliability over single-view RGB-D grounding and fine-tuned VLA baselines. We further demonstrate long-horizon manipulation through closed-loop status verification and replan, enabling zero-shot execution on unseen objects and tool-use tasks in novel scenes.
tldr: A zero-shot framework that uses a VLM to ground language instructions into 3D task plans from multi-view RGB images for long-horizon dexterous manipulation, combining triangulation and ray voting to lift 2D keypoints to 3D for pick-and-place and tool-use.
tldr_zh: 提出一种零样本框架，利用VLM从多视角RGB图像中将语言指令转化为3D任务规划，通过三角测量和射线投票将2D关键点提升至3D，实现远程灵巧操作及工具使用。
summary_zh: 我们提出一个零样本框架，用于长时程灵巧操作，该框架能够将语言指令从标定的多视角RGB图像中，转化为可执行的3D任务规划。不同于训练端到端策略，我们的系统利用视觉语言模型（VLM）生成参考框架下的任务定位与原始层级的2D关键点，再通过多视角融合将其提升至3D空间。这一提升过程将逐视角VLM定位结果的三角测量与参考视角射线投票相结合——后者沿语义相机射线搜索，在相邻视角中寻找几何一致的候选点。生成的3D关键点既能支持抓取放置操作，也能支持工具使用：对于工具使用，我们根据推断出的技能类别检索对应的物体中心原子动作，并将其存储的6D工具轨迹与场景对齐；对于灵巧执行，我们将提升后的抓取关键点扩展为任务条件化的抓取可行域，并通过手臂-手部运动生成器产生可行的抓取-运动对。实际实验表明，相较于单视角RGB-D定位与微调VLA基线方法，我们的系统在3D定位精度与执行可靠性上均有提升。我们进一步通过闭环状态验证与重规划展示了长时程操作能力，可在未见物体与新奇场景中零样本执行工具使用任务。

title: Playful Agentic Robot Learning
summary: Current agentic robot systems can write executable Code-as-Policy programs, observe feedback, and revise behavior across multiple attempts, but they remain largely task-driven: reusable skills are acquired only after explicit instructions. We study Playful Agentic Robot Learning, where an embodied coding agent uses self-directed play as a continual skill-learning stage before downstream tasks arrive. We introduce RATs, Robotics Agent Teams designed for play-time skill acquisition. During play, RATs proposes novel yet learnable exploratory tasks, plans and executes robot-code policies, verifies intermediate progress, diagnoses failures, retries with dense, step-level feedback, and distills successful executions into a persistent code skill library. At test time, the agent reuses relevant skills from this frozen library to help solve new tasks. Experiments in LIBERO-PRO and MolmoSpaces show that play-learned skills improve held-out downstream tasks over no-play and random-play baselines, with 20.6 and 17.0 percentage-point gains over CaP-Agent0 on LIBERO-PRO and MolmoSpaces, respectively. Moreover, the learned skills can be plugged into other inference-time Code-as-Policy agents by simply retrieving them into the context, improving RoboSuite and real-world transfer by 8.9 and 8.8 points, respectively, without finetuning the underlying model.
tldr: This paper introduces RATs, a playful agentic robot learning system where an embodied coding agent autonomously proposes and practices exploratory tasks before downstream tasks arrive, distilling successful executions into a reusable code skill library that improves task performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了RATs，一种游戏式自主机器人学习系统，其中具身编码代理在接收到下游任务前自主提出并练习探索性任务，将成功执行提炼为可复用的代码技能库，从而提升任务表现。
summary_zh: 当前自主机器人系统能够编写可执行的代码即策略（Code-as-Policy）程序、观察反馈并在多次尝试中修正自身行为，但其本质上仍以任务为驱动：可复用技能仅在明确指令下达后才被习得。我们研究了一种名为“游戏式自主机器人学习”（Playful Agentic Robot Learning）的方法，该方法将具身编码智能体在下游任务到来前的自驱型游戏行为作为持续性的技能学习阶段。为此，我们提出RATs（机器人智能体团队），专用于游戏阶段的技能习得。在游戏过程中，RATs会提出新颖且可学习的探索性任务，规划并执行机器人代码策略，验证中间进度，诊断失败原因，通过密集的步骤级反馈进行重试，并将成功执行过程提炼至持久化的代码技能库中。测试阶段，智能体从该冻结的技能库中复用相关技能以辅助解决新任务。在LIBERO-PRO和MolmoSpaces上的实验表明，相较于无游戏和随机游戏基线，通过游戏习得的技能能显著提升留出下游任务的表现：在LIBERO-PRO和MolmoSpaces上分别相较于CaP-Agent0取得了20.6和17.0个百分点的提升。此外，只需将习得技能检索至上下文，即可将其嵌入其他推理阶段的代码即策略智能体，在无需微调底层模型的情况下，分别在RoboSuite和真实环境迁移中提升8.9和8.8个百分点的性能。

title: Does VLA Even Know the Basics? Measuring Commonsense and World Knowledge Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Embodied Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically obtained by fine-tuning powerful pretrained VLMs on robotics data, yet it is unclear how much commonsense and factual knowledge they retain after adaptation. Failures on knowledge-sensitive tasks are ambiguous, conflating missing knowledge with poor generalization of low-level control. We introduce Act2Answer, a lightweight protocol that adapts VLM knowledge benchmarks to VLA evaluation by requiring agents to answer through action. Each question becomes a short tabletop episode where the agent performs a single object-placement action to select among candidate answers, yielding an action-grounded success rate with reduced control confounds. We curate a test suite of such environments across diverse commonsense and world-knowledge categories and introduce layerwise intent probing to localize answer-relevant information across the VLM backbone and action head. In a large-scale study of 7 VLA models and 9 VLM baselines, we systematically rank models across categories, finding that VLAs show solid performance on simple concepts while exhibiting larger gaps on richer semantic categories relative to their source VLMs, that VQA co-training is associated with better knowledge retention, and that answer-relevant signals peak in middle VLA layers but attenuate in upper layers. Act2Answer is available at https://tttonyalpha.github.io/act2answer/.
tldr: This paper introduces Act2Answer, a protocol to evaluate commonsense and world knowledge retention in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by converting VLM knowledge benchmarks into tabletop action-based tasks, and shows that VLA models retain basic knowledge but lose richer semantics compared to their source VLMs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Act2Answer协议，通过将VLM知识基准转化为桌面操作任务来评估视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型的常识和世界知识保留能力，结果显示VLA模型能保留基础知识但较其源VLM在丰富语义类别上存在较大差距。
summary_zh: 具身视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常通过在机器人数据上微调强大的预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）获得，然而适配后它们保留了多少常识和事实知识尚不明确。在知识敏感任务上的失败是模糊的，混淆了知识缺失与底层控制泛化能力不足。我们提出Act2Answer，一种轻量级协议，通过要求智能体以动作形式作答，将VLM知识基准适配为VLA评估。每个问题转化为一个短暂的桌面场景，智能体通过执行单个物体放置动作在候选答案中进行选择，从而得到以动作为基础的、控制混杂因素降低的成功率。我们整理了涵盖多种常识与世界知识类别的此类环境测试集，并引入逐层意图探测方法，以定位VLM主干网络和动作头中与答案相关的信息。在对7个VLA模型和9个VLM基线的大规模研究中，我们系统地对各模型在不同类别上进行排序，发现VLA在简单概念上表现稳健，但在较丰富语义类别上相对于其源VLM显示出更大差距；VQA联合训练与更好的知识保留相关；与答案相关的信号在VLA中间层达到峰值，但在上层衰减。Act2Answer可访问https://tttonyalpha.github.io/act2answer/。

title: Invertible Neural Network Adapter for One-Step Flow Matching in Robot Manipulation
summary: This paper presents an invertible neural network adapter for general robotic manipulation, designed to generate precise high-dimensional actions conditioned on multimodal observations, including visual, linguistic, and proprioceptive inputs, through a one-step denoising process. Built upon a flow-matching formulation, the proposed adapter effectively constrains the action generation trajectory within an invertible latent space, thereby enabling efficient and high-quality dexterous action synthesis with only a single inference step. Compared with conventional iterative flow-matching policies, the proposed framework substantially reduces inference complexity while maintaining strong action prediction accuracy and stability. Extensive experiments are conducted across a diverse set of simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic platforms to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Across simulation benchmarks, the proposed adapter consistently demonstrates superior or near state-of-the-art performance on a wide range of manipulation tasks. Furthermore, real-world experiments reveal a significant improvement in inference efficiency for vision-language-action (VLA) models, reducing the average inference latency from 110 ms to 61 ms while maintaining strong task performance.
tldr: This paper introduces an invertible neural network adapter for flow-matching policies that enables one-step denoising for robotic manipulation, significantly reducing inference latency while maintaining high action prediction accuracy across simulation and real-world VLA tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种可逆神经网络适配器，用于流匹配策略，实现单步去噪的机器人操作，在保持高动作预测精度的同时显著降低推理延迟，并在仿真和真实世界VLA任务中验证了有效性。
summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向通用机器人操作的可逆神经网络适配器，旨在通过单步去噪过程，基于多模态观测（包括视觉、语言和本体感知输入）生成精确的高维动作。该适配器基于流匹配公式构建，有效将动作生成轨迹约束在可逆潜空间内，从而仅需单次推理步骤即可实现高效、高质量的灵巧动作合成。相较于传统的迭代式流匹配策略，本文框架在保持强动作预测精度与稳定性的同时，显著降低了推理复杂度。通过在多种仿真基准测试与真实机器人平台上开展大量实验，验证了所提方法的有效性。在仿真基准测试中，该适配器在各类操作任务上持续展现出优于或接近最先进的性能。此外，真实世界实验揭示了其在视觉-语言-动作模型推理效率上的显著提升：在保持良好任务表现的同时，平均推理延迟从110毫秒降低至61毫秒。

title: Learning to Annotate Delayed and False AEB Events: A Practical System for Extreme Class Imbalance and Asymmetric Label Noise
summary: Autonomous Emergency Braking (AEB) optimization relies on accurately annotated real-world trigger events, particularly rare but critical delayed and false AEB triggers that expose system deficiencies. However, these minority samples comprise less than 5% of thousands of daily triggers, making manual annotation prohibitively expensive at scale. We present the first automated AEB annotation framework to address this problem. During development, we identified two fundamental challenges that severely impair delayed/false trigger annotation accuracy: (1) Extreme class imbalance where delayed/false triggers are overwhelmed by true triggers; (2) Asymmetric label noise where mislabeled majority samples (true triggers) suppress minority samples (delayed/false triggers) learning. To overcome these challenges, we propose two key innovations: (1) Specific data augmentation that synthesizes realistic samples by manipulating focal target attributes, transplanting ego-vehicle dynamics, and masking non-focal agents; (2) noise suppression using stable hardness estimation and probe-guided adaptive threshold to clean mislabeled true trigger samples. Crucially, we deploy our model as a practical annotation system with full-stack architecture, efficiently identifying critical delayed/false triggers from thousands of daily AEB events. Production results demonstrate 80% improvement in recall of delayed/false triggers and 50% reduction in manual workload. Beyond immediate gains, the system enables continuous self-improvement through accumulated high-quality annotations, establishing a necessary data foundation for on-vehicle AEB system optimization
tldr: A first automated annotation framework for delayed and false AEB events, using specialized data augmentation and noise suppression to handle extreme class imbalance and asymmetric label noise, achieving significant recall improvement and workload reduction in production.
tldr_zh: 首个自动标注延迟/误触发AEB事件的框架，通过专用数据增强和噪声抑制技术应对极端类别不平衡与非对称标签噪声，在生产中显著提升召回率并减少人工工作量。
summary_zh: 自主紧急制动（AEB）优化依赖于准确标注的真实触发事件，尤其是那些暴露系统缺陷的罕见但关键的延迟触发与误触发事件。然而，这些少数类样本在每日数千次触发事件中占比不足5%，使得大规模人工标注成本过高。我们首次提出自动化AEB标注框架来解决此问题。在开发过程中，我们识别出严重损害延迟/误触发标注准确性的两个根本性挑战：（1）极端类别不平衡——延迟/误触发样本被真实触发样本淹没；（2）非对称标签噪声——被错误标注的多数类样本（真实触发）抑制了少数类样本（延迟/误触发）的学习。为克服这些挑战，我们提出两项关键创新：（1）特定数据增强——通过操控焦点目标属性、移植自车动力学特征及遮蔽非焦点智能体，合成真实场景样本；（2）噪声抑制——利用稳定难易度估计与探针引导自适应阈值，清洗被错误标注的真实触发样本。关键突破在于，我们将模型部署为全栈架构的实用标注系统，每日从数千次AEB事件中高效识别关键延迟/误触发样本。生产结果表明，延迟/误触发召回率提升80%，人工工作量减少50%。除即时收益外，该系统通过积累高质量标注实现持续自我优化，为车载AEB系统优化奠定必要的数据基础。

title: HT-Bench: Benchmarking and Learning Dexterous Full-Hand Tactile Representations with Egocentric Vision
summary: Establishing a universal benchmark for tactile representation learning in robotic manipulation remains challenging due to the diversity of tactile sensor designs, data formats, and robot embodiments. Rather than seeking to establish such, we explore a scalable and promising direction for future development: egocentric vision paired with full-hand tactile data. To this end, we introduce \textbf{HT-Bench}, a large-scale multi-task benchmark for dexterous full-hand tactile sensing, comprising 10M RGB frames and 7.8M tactile frames collected across 226 tasks. HT-Bench evaluates tactile representations from three key perspectives: whether they encode meaningful contact geometry, whether they can align tactile observations with visual information, and whether they generalize to unseen tasks. To assess these capabilities, HT-Bench includes four tasks: fine-grained tactile similarity retrieval, masked tactile inpainting, vision-to-tactile synthesis, and multimodal tactile frame prediction. We further propose \textbf{HandTouch}, a vector-quantized vision--tactile encoder that learns tactile representations through progressive spatial, cross-modal, and temporal training. Across HT-Bench, HandTouch consistently outperforms representative tactile encoder baselines, improving Recall@5 on fine-grained tactile similarity retrieval from 74.65\% to 85.23\%, reducing RMSE on masked tactile inpainting from 0.022 to 0.010, and increasing OOD cIoU on vision-to-tactile synthesis from 0.628 to 0.705. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of HandTouch and suggest that large-scale egocentric full-hand tactile data provides a scalable basis for evaluating and advancing tactile representation learning in dexterous manipulation.
tldr: HT-Bench is a large-scale benchmark for dexterous full-hand tactile sensing using egocentric vision, and HandTouch is a vector-quantized vision-tactile encoder that achieves strong results on tactile representation tasks relevant to robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: HT-Bench 是一个基于第一人称视觉的灵巧全手触觉感知大规模基准，HandTouch 是一种向量量化的视觉-触觉编码器，在机器人操作相关的触觉表征任务上取得了优异结果。
summary_zh: 建立机器人操作中触觉表征学习的通用基准，因触觉传感器设计、数据格式及机器人本体的多样性而充满挑战。不同于寻求建立此类基准，我们探索了一条面向未来发展的可扩展且前景广阔的研究方向：以自我中心视觉配以全手触觉数据。为此，我们提出\textbf{HT-Bench}——一个面向灵巧全手触觉感知的大规模多任务基准，包含226项任务中采集的1000万帧RGB图像与780万帧触觉数据。HT-Bench从三个关键维度评估触觉表征：是否编码有意义的接触几何信息、能否将触觉观测与视觉信息对齐、以及能否泛化至未见任务。为评估这些能力，HT-Bench涵盖四项任务：细粒度触觉相似性检索、掩膜触觉修复、视觉-触觉合成及多模态触觉帧预测。我们进一步提出\textbf{HandTouch}——一种矢量量化视觉-触觉编码器，通过渐进式空间、跨模态与时间训练学习触觉表征。在HT-Bench的全部任务中，HandTouch持续优于代表性触觉编码器基线：将细粒度触觉相似性检索的Recall@5从74.65%提升至85.23%，掩膜触觉修复的RMSE从0.022降至0.010，视觉-触觉合成的OOD cIoU从0.628提高至0.705。这些结果验证了HandTouch的有效性，并表明大规模自我中心全手触觉数据为评估与推进灵巧操作中的触觉表征学习提供了可扩展基础。

title: ReSiReg: Towards Spatially Consistent Semantics in Language-Conditioned Robotic Tasks
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable robots to follow open-language instructions. However, dense VLM embeddings have shown to be noisy and lack spatial consistency. This is problematic for robotic applications, which require simultaneous reasoning over semantics and 3D space. We examine spatial structure across recent VLMs and propose ReSiReg, a feature reconstruction method that uses spatially consistent VLM intermediates to improve dense language-grounded retrieval. ReSiReg clusters intermediates into visual prototypes, derives their language descriptors, and reconstructs each patch as a soft mixture of prototype-level language embeddings. We evaluate quantitatively on OVSS and 3D mapping across backbones, and qualitatively in real-world manipulation scenes. Quantitative results show improved dense retrieval; manipulation scenes show more spatially consistent target activations. We further provide a compact 25M dense VLM for robotic applications, substantially smaller than and competitive with ViT-B baselines. Available at https://resireg.github.io
tldr: ReSiReg improves spatial consistency in dense VLM embeddings for language-conditioned robotic tasks by reconstructing patch features as a mixture of prototype-level language descriptors from clustered visual intermediates.
tldr_zh: ReSiReg通过将视觉中间特征聚类为原型并重构为原型级语言描述的软混合，提升了VLM稠密嵌入在语言引导机器人任务中的空间一致性。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型使机器人能够遵循开放式语言指令。然而，密集的VLM嵌入已被证明存在噪声且缺乏空间一致性。这对于需要在语义与三维空间上进行同步推理的机器人应用而言是个问题。我们研究了近期VLM中的空间结构，并提出ReSiReg——一种利用空间一致的VLM中间表示来改进密集语言接地检索的特征重建方法。ReSiReg将中间表示聚类为视觉原型，推导其语言描述符，并将每个图像块重建为原型级语言嵌入的软混合。我们在跨骨干网络的开放词汇语义分割与三维建图任务上进行了定量评估，并在真实世界操作场景中进行了定性评估。定量结果表明密集检索性能得到提升；操作场景中显示出空间更一致的目标激活。我们进一步提供了一个紧凑的25M参数密集VLM用于机器人应用，其规模显著小于ViT-B基线模型且性能相当。可访问https://resireg.github.io获取。

title: Motion-Focused Latent Action Enables Cross-Embodiment VLA Training from Human EgoVideos
summary: Training generalist Vision-Language-Action(VLA) models typically requires massive, diverse robotic datasets with high-fidelity action annotations. While egocentric human manipulation videos are abundant and capture significant environmental diversity, the absence of action labels makes them difficult to use in conventional training paradigms. To address this, we propose a latent-action-based framework designed to extract general action priors from unlabeled human videos. The architecture features a Hybrid Disentangled VQ-VAE that decouples motion dynamics from environmental backgrounds through physical masks, enabling the construction of a cross-embodiment action codebook. By pre-training on human videos with the codebook, the VLM backbone learns deep representations of action intent. For adaptation to specific embodiments, we introduce an intent-perception decoupling strategy where the VLM predicts the action intent while a separate frozen visual encoder provides state-specific features to the action expert, thereby reducing action hallucinations. Results in simulation and real-world environments show that our method, pre-trained exclusively on unlabeled human videos, performs competitively with state-of-the-art VLA models trained on massive annotated datasets, requiring only 50 trajectories for downstream adaptation.
tldr: Proposes a latent action framework using a Hybrid Disentangled VQ-VAE to extract cross-embodiment action priors from unlabeled human egocentric videos, enabling VLA training that achieves competitive performance with SOTA models using only 50 trajectories for adaptation.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于潜在动作的框架，通过混合解耦VQ-VAE从无标注的人类第一人称视频中提取跨本体动作先验，使VLA模型仅需50条轨迹即可达到与依赖海量标注数据的SOTA模型相当的性能。
summary_zh: 训练通用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常需要大规模、多样化的机器人数据集，并配备高保真度的动作标注。尽管以自我为中心的人类操作视频数量丰富且捕捉了显著的环境多样性，但缺乏动作标签使其难以应用于传统训练范式。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于潜在动作的框架，旨在从未标注的人类视频中提取通用动作先验。该架构采用一种混合解耦矢量量化变分自编码器，通过物理掩码将运动动力学与环境背景分离，从而构建跨具身动作码本。通过利用该码本在人类视频上进行预训练，视觉-语言模型骨干网络能够学习到动作意图的深层表征。针对特定具身的适配，我们引入了一种意图-感知解耦策略：视觉-语言模型预测动作意图，同时一个独立的冻结视觉编码器为动作专家提供状态特定特征，从而减少动作幻觉。仿真与现实环境中的结果表明，我们的方法仅从未标注的人类视频进行预训练，在与基于大规模标注数据集训练的最先进VLA模型的竞争中表现出色，且仅需50条轨迹即可完成下游适配。

title: ZiMPedance: Impedance-Aware ZMP Modeling and Control for Payload Carrying with Quadruped Robots
summary: Load transportation with quadruped robots is strongly affected by the dynamics of the physical interface between the robot and the load. Passive spring-based arms reduce weight and complexity compared to active manipulators, but their spring-damper dynamics can introduce oscillatory forces that degrade locomotion stability. This paper derives an extended Zero Moment Point (ZMP) formulation that includes passive payload-interface dynamics, relating stiffness, damping, and payload mass to the stability margin. The analysis shows that underdamped configurations can resonate with locomotion harmonics. Based on this insight, we augment a Single Rigid Body Dynamics model with passive subsystem dynamics and integrate it into a Model Predictive Control framework. In simulation, the proposed controller reduces stability violations by up to $10\times$, from $7.0\%$ to $0.7\%$, and increase locomotion efficiency by lowering horizontal ground reaction force effort by up to $15\%$ compared to a nominal baseline. Hardware experiments with a $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ payload show stable locomotion under pull-release disturbances where the nominal controller fails. The same model also enables end-effector tracking through passive arm dynamics without direct arm actuation.
tldr: This paper extends ZMP stability criteria for quadruped locomotion to account for passive payload-arm dynamics, and integrates the resulting model into an MPC controller to improve stability and efficiency during load carrying.
tldr_zh: 本文针对四足机器人负载运输中被动载荷臂的弹簧阻尼动力学，扩展了ZMP稳定性判据，并将该模型嵌入MPC控制器中，显著提升了稳定性和效率。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
四足机器人负载运输受机器人-负载物理界面动力学的显著影响。与主动机械臂相比，被动弹簧臂可降低重量与复杂度，但其弹簧-阻尼器动力学可能引入振荡力，从而削弱运动稳定性。本文推导了包含被动载荷-界面动力学的扩展零力矩点（ZMP）公式，将刚度、阻尼及载荷质量与稳定裕度相关联。分析表明，欠阻尼配置可能与运动谐波产生共振。基于这一发现，我们将被动子系统动力学融入单刚体动力学模型，并将其集成至模型预测控制框架中。仿真结果显示，所提出的控制器将稳定性违规率从7.0%降低至0.7%，降幅高达10倍，并通过降低水平地面反作用力（最多减少15%）提升运动效率。硬件实验结果表明，在名义控制器失效的拉拽-释放扰动下，搭载2千克载荷的机器人仍能实现稳定运动。同一模型还可在无直接机械臂驱动的情况下，通过被动臂动力学实现末端执行器轨迹跟踪。

title: A Scalable Embodied Intelligence Platform for Seamless Real-to-Sim-to-Real Transfer of Household Mobile Manipulation Tasks
summary: Mobile manipulation is a fundamental capability in embodied intelligence robotics. The growing demand for robust and generalizable manipulation in unstructured household environments has driven rapid progress in embodied intelligence platforms. However, achieving a seamless transfer across the real-to-sim-to-real cycle faces three key challenges, including costly high-fidelity simulation scenes reconstruction, the complexity of systematic strategy evaluation in simulation, and incompatible real-world deployments. To address these challenges, we develop BestMan, a scalable and seamless real-to-sim-to-real platform that bridges the gap between the simulation and the real world, enabling effective strategy development, integration, and deployment for household mobile manipulation. Specifically, we design a novel Automated Scene Generation (ASG) module to reconstruct realistic simulations from real observations. Then, we propose a simulation-guided task formalization and skill learning architecture that supports the flexible integration and large-scale evaluations of hybrid skill strategies in simulation. Finally, to enhance the real-world scalability, we develop a Hardware-agnostic and Unified Middleware (HUM) to ensure seamless and compatible sim-to-real transfer across heterogeneous mobile manipulators for real deployments. Experimental results demonstrate the superior performance of our proposed platform in establishing standardized benchmarks and facilitating promising research in the field of mobile manipulation.
tldr: BestMan is a platform that enables seamless real-to-sim-to-real transfer for household mobile manipulation via automated scene generation, simulation-guided skill learning, and a hardware-agnostic middleware.
tldr_zh: BestMan 是一个通过自动化场景生成、仿真引导的技能学习和硬件无关中间件实现家用移动操作从真实到仿真再到真实无缝迁移的平台。
summary_zh: 移动操作是具身智能机器人领域的一项基础能力。非结构化家居环境中对鲁棒且可泛化操作的需求日益增长，推动了具身智能平台的快速发展。然而，在真实-仿真-真实循环中实现无缝迁移面临三个关键挑战：高保真仿真场景重建成本高昂、仿真中系统化策略评估的复杂性，以及真实世界部署中的兼容性问题。为解决这些挑战，我们开发了BestMan——一个可扩展且无缝衔接的"真实-仿真-真实"平台，该平台弥合了仿真与真实世界之间的鸿沟，为家居移动操作中的策略开发、集成与部署提供了有效支持。具体而言，我们设计了一种新颖的自动化场景生成模块，可从真实观测数据重建高保真仿真场景；接着提出了一种仿真引导的任务形式化与技能学习架构，支持在仿真环境中灵活集成混合技能策略并进行大规模评估；最后，为增强真实世界的可扩展性，我们开发了硬件无关的统一中间件，确保异构移动操作器在真实部署中实现无缝且兼容的仿真-真实迁移。实验结果表明，我们提出的平台在建立标准化基准测试以及推动移动操作领域前沿研究方面展现出卓越性能。

title: ROBOSHACKLES: A Safety Dataset for Human-Injury Prevention in Embodied Foundation Models
summary: Embodied Foundation Models (EFMs) integrate multimodal understanding, future-state reasoning, and executable robot actions. Yet their safety alignment for human-injury prevention remains underexplored, primarily because real-world data of robots harming humans or creating hazardous household situations cannot be safely or ethically collected. To address this challenge, we propose a safety-critical data construction pipeline for human-injury prevention in EFMs.Starting from real DROID observations, our construction pipeline proceeds through scene understanding, hazard-aware image editing, temporal prompt generation, and single-pass rollout synthesis. The temporal prompts specify the expected scene evolution, while Wan2.7 synthesizes realistic robotic rollouts from the edited hazardous states in a single pass. Using this pipeline, we construct ROBOSHACKLES, a 10,000-clip robotic video dataset derived from real DROID observations, spanning two direct-harm and four indirect-harm categories. To ensure dataset quality, we assess task completion and visual quality with automatic metrics, and evaluate six representative EFMs under a refusal-based safety criterion. Results show that all evaluated models produce unsafe actions in the tested safety-critical scenarios, yielding a 100% unsafe action generation rate. ROBOSHACKLES serves as a scalable benchmark and training resource for refusal learning and hazard anticipation before robot action execution.The dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/YZW00/RoboShackles.
tldr: Introduces RoboShackles, a 10,000-clip safety dataset for embodied foundation models, generated via a pipeline that edits real robot observations into hazardous scenarios, and evaluates six EFMs all of which generate unsafe actions.
tldr_zh: 提出了 RoboShackles，一个包含一万个机器人视频片段的安全数据集，通过编辑真实机器人观测生成危险场景，并评估了六个具身基础模型，结果显示所有模型均产生不安全动作。
summary_zh: 具身基础模型整合了多模态理解、未来状态推理与可执行机器人动作。然而，其在预防人体伤害方面的安全对齐问题尚未得到充分探索，主要原因在于无法安全且合乎伦理地收集机器人伤害人类或制造家庭危险情景的真实世界数据。针对这一挑战，我们提出了一种面向具身基础模型人体伤害预防的安全关键数据构建管线。该管线以真实DROID观测数据为起点，依次进行场景理解、风险感知图像编辑、时序提示生成与单次推演合成。其中，时序提示规定了预期的场景演化过程，而Wan2.7则基于编辑后的风险状态，通过单次推演合成逼真的机器人行为序列。利用该管线，我们构建了ROBOSHACKLES数据集——一个源自真实DROID观测数据、包含10,000段机器人视频片段的数据集，覆盖两类直接伤害与四类间接伤害类别。为确保数据质量，我们采用自动指标评估任务完成度与视觉质量，并基于拒绝式安全准则对六个代表性具身基础模型进行评估。结果表明，所有被评估模型在测试的安全关键场景中均生成了不安全动作，不安全动作生成率达100%。ROBOSHACKLES可作为机器人动作执行前拒绝学习与风险预判的可扩展基准数据集及训练资源。该数据集已在https://huggingface.co/datasets/YZW00/RoboShackles 公开。

title: SC3-Eval: Evaluating Robot Foundation Models via Self-Consistent Video Generation
summary: Evaluating generalist robot manipulation policies in the real world is expensive, slow, and difficult to scale. Action-conditioned video world models offer a scalable alternative by simulating policy rollouts. Autoregressive rollouts accumulate compounding errors, observations across multiple camera views must remain mutually consistent, and the evaluator must generalize to policies whose behaviors lie outside the training distribution. We address these challenges with SC3-Eval, a self-consistent video generation recipe that adapts a pre-trained video foundation model into an accurate policy evaluator by enforcing three complementary forms of consistency. First, forward-inverse dynamics consistency jointly trains the model to predict frames from actions and to recover actions from frames, anchoring generated rollouts to a physically plausible action manifold and counteracting the drift a forward-only model cannot penalize. Second, cross-view consistency trains the model to inpaint each camera view from the other, keeping the multi-camera observation coherent over long rollouts without any explicit memory mechanism. Third, test-time consistency reuses the inverse dynamics mode at inference as a per-action-chunk uncertainty signal that terminates rollouts whose generated frames drift away from the requested actions. We also demonstrate SC3-Eval rollouts reproduce the failure modes that policies exhibit in real-world rollouts, supporting fine-grained diagnostic comparison rather than aggregate ranking alone. Across seven real-world vision-language-action policies, SC3-Eval attains a closed-loop Pearson correlation of $0.929$ and MMRV of $0.119$, outperforming three strong prior video-model-based baselines, and generalizes to new tasks.
tldr: SC3-Eval adapts a pre-trained video foundation model into a policy evaluator for robot manipulation by enforcing forward-inverse dynamics consistency, cross-view consistency, and test-time consistency, achieving high correlation with real-world rollouts.
tldr_zh: SC3-Eval通过强制前向-逆向动力学一致性、跨视角一致性和测试时一致性，将预训练的视频基础模型适配为机器人操作策略的评估器，实现了与真实世界 rollout 的高相关性。
summary_zh: 在现实世界中评估通用机器人操作策略既昂贵、缓慢且难以规模化。基于动作条件的视频世界模型通过模拟策略推演提供了一种可扩展的替代方案。自回归推演会累积复合误差，多摄像头视角的观测必须保持相互一致，且评估器需泛化至行为超出训练分布的策略。我们通过SC3-Eval应对这些挑战——这是一种自一致性视频生成方案，通过施加三种互补的一致性约束，将预训练视频基础模型适配为精确的策略评估器。其一，前向-反向动力学一致性训练模型既能根据动作预测帧，又能从帧中恢复动作，将生成的推演锚定于物理可行的动作流形，并抵消仅前向模型无法惩罚的漂移。其二，跨视角一致性训练模型从其他视角补全每个摄像头视角，无需显式记忆机制即可在长推演中保持多摄像头观测的一致性。其三，测试时一致性在推理阶段复用反向动力学模式作为每动作块的不确定性信号，终止生成帧偏离指定动作的推演。我们还证明SC3-Eval推演能复现策略在现实推演中表现出的失效模式，支持细粒度诊断性比较而非仅聚合排名。在七项现实视觉-语言-动作策略的测试中，SC3-Eval达到了0.929的闭环皮尔逊相关系数与0.119的MMRV，优于三个基于视频模型的强基线方法，并能泛化至新任务。

title: Admittance-Based Surface Alignment for Human-in-the-Loop Robotic Visual Inspection
summary: Precision visual inspection underpins quality assurance across aerospace, semiconductor, and medical manufacturing, where undetected surface anomalies on high-value parts translate directly into scrap, rework, and field failures. Robotic visual inspection requires precise alignment between the end-effector and local surface geometry in the presence of perception noise and surface irregularities. In industrial settings, a human operator is often kept in the loop via teleoperation or shared autonomy, introducing real-time adjustments that render purely offline motion planning inadequate. This motivates control architectures capable of reactive, compliant behavior under combined human and perceptual uncertainty. This paper presents a novel real-time, closed-loop robotic orientation control pipeline for precision visual inspection, with an admittance-based framework that unifies operator input and perception-driven surface alignment. We design the end-effector as a virtual sphere moving through a viscous medium, such that the resulting physically interpretable mass--damper system generates synchronized, compliant motion from orientation error and operator commands. We validate the framework on a 6-DOF manipulator demonstrating stable normal-tracking and a final mean orientation error of 0.4°.
tldr: This paper proposes a real-time admittance-based control pipeline for robotic visual inspection that unifies human teleoperation and perception-driven surface alignment, achieving 0.4° mean orientation error on a 6-DOF manipulator.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于导纳的实时控制框架，用于机器人视觉检测，将人类遥操作与感知驱动的表面对齐统一，在6自由度机械臂上实现了0.4°的平均方向误差。
summary_zh: 精密视觉检测是航空航天、半导体和医疗制造业质量保障的核心环节，这些领域中高价值部件上未被发现的表面异常会直接导致报废、返工及现场故障。机器人视觉检测需要在存在感知噪声和表面不规则性的情况下，实现末端执行器与局部表面几何结构的精确对齐。在工业场景中，通常通过遥操作或共享自主性将人类操作员纳入控制闭环，其引入的实时调整使纯离线运动规划难以满足需求。这促使控制架构需具备在人类与感知双重不确定性下实现响应性、柔顺性行为的能力。本文提出了一种用于精密视觉检测的新型实时闭环机器人定向控制流水线，其基于导纳框架统一了操作员输入与感知驱动的表面对齐。我们将末端执行器设计为在粘性介质中运动的虚拟球体，使由此产生的具有物理可解释性的质量-阻尼系统能够根据定向误差和操作指令生成同步柔顺运动。通过六自由度机械臂验证该框架，展示了稳定的法向跟踪能力，最终平均定向误差为0.4°。

title: Benchmarking Action Spaces in Reinforcement Learning for Vision-based Robotic Manipulation
summary: In real-world reinforcement learning (RL), the choice of action space can play a key role in shaping motion smoothness, safety, and overall task performance. In this study, we evaluate pose increment, pose velocity, joint position increment, and joint velocity across two vision-based manipulation tasks: object picking and pushing. We train policies in simulation and deploy them to the real world using sim-to-real transfer. We find that action-space representation indeed significantly affects sim-to-real performance. In particular, we find that the joint velocity action space is best for the vision-based picking and pushing tasks in terms of smoothness and final task performance. We also provide practical guidance for RL practitioners in choosing action spaces for both simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr: This paper benchmarks different action space representations (pose increment, pose velocity, joint position increment, joint velocity) for vision-based RL robotic manipulation and shows that joint velocity performs best for sim-to-real transfer in picking and pushing tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文针对基于视觉的机器人操作强化学习，基准测试了不同动作空间表示（位姿增量、位姿速度、关节位置增量、关节速度），并发现关节速度在模拟到现实的迁移中表现最佳。
summary_zh: 在真实世界的强化学习（RL）中，动作空间的选择对运动平滑性、安全性及整体任务性能起着关键作用。本研究针对两项基于视觉的操作任务——物体拾取与推挤，评估了位姿增量、位姿速度、关节位置增量及关节速度四种动作空间。我们通过仿真训练策略，并利用仿真到真实迁移技术将其部署至真实世界。研究发现，动作空间表示确实显著影响仿真到真实迁移的性能。具体而言，在基于视觉的拾取与推挤任务中，关节速度动作空间在平滑性和最终任务性能方面表现最优。此外，我们还为RL从业者提供了在仿真及真实世界实验中选择动作空间的实用指导。

title: DREAM-Chunk: Reactive Action Chunking with Latent World Model
summary: Action chunking has become a common interface for vision-language-action (VLA) models, enabling low-frequency policy inference to drive high-frequency robot execution. However, once an action chunk is committed, its open-loop execution can be brittle under stochastic dynamics, hardware execution errors, and partial observability. We propose DREAM-Chunk, a test-time scaling method that augments chunking-based policies with a lightweight latent world model, without requiring additional policy fine-tuning. At test time, DREAM-Chunk samples multiple candidate action chunks, rolls out their predicted latent futures, and selects actions from the chunk whose predicted state best matches the observed rollout. In this way, DREAM-Chunk uses additional test-time computation to cover multiple plausible stochastic futures and improve reactivity during long-horizon chunk execution. On the Kinetix benchmark, DREAM-Chunk improves robustness under increasing action noise and benefits from larger candidate sample sizes, especially when demonstrations contain corrective behaviors. We further validate DREAM-Chunk on four manipulation tasks across two robot platforms and two VLA policies under various sources of stochasticity. Across simulation and hardware experiments, DREAM-Chunk improves the robustness of action-chunking policies in stochastic dynamics.
tldr: DREAM-Chunk enhances action-chunking VLA policies by using a lightweight latent world model at test time to select actions that best match observed rollouts, improving robustness under stochastic dynamics without requiring additional fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: DREAM-Chunk通过使用轻量级潜在世界模型在测试时选择与观察到的滚动结果最匹配的动作，增强了动作分块VLA策略的鲁棒性，无需额外微调即可应对随机动态。
summary_zh: 动作分块已成为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的常见接口，使得低频策略推理能够驱动高频机器人执行。然而，一旦动作分块被提交，在随机动力学、硬件执行误差和部分可观测性条件下，其开环执行可能变得脆弱。我们提出DREAM-Chunk，一种测试时扩展方法，通过轻量级潜在世界模型增强基于分块的策略，且无需额外的策略微调。在测试时，DREAM-Chunk采样多个候选动作分块，推演其预测的潜在未来轨迹，并从预测状态与实际执行结果匹配最佳的分块中选择动作。通过这种方式，DREAM-Chunk利用额外的测试时计算覆盖多种可能的随机未来，并在长周期分块执行中提升响应性。在Kinetix基准测试中，DREAM-Chunk在增强动作噪声下的鲁棒性得到提升，且受益于更大的候选样本规模，尤其在演示包含纠正行为时。我们进一步在两个机器人平台的四项操作任务和两种VLA策略上验证DREAM-Chunk，涵盖多种随机性来源。在仿真和硬件实验中，DREAM-Chunk提升了动作分块策略在随机动力学中的鲁棒性。

title: VEGA: Learning Navigation VLAs from In-the-Wild Egocentric Video with Geometric Trajectory Supervision
summary: We introduce VEGA, an approach for training navigation VisionLanguage-Action (VLA) models from unlabeled egocentric navigation videos. Internet-scale egocentric videos provide a scalable source of navigation-relevant visual observations, capturing cluttered scenes, close-range obstacles, and natural human motion through real-world spaces. However, these videos are not directly usable for policy learning because they do not provide obstacle-aware trajectories conditioned on explicit navigation goals in the robot's coordinate frame. VEGA addresses this gap by reconstructing local scene geometry from monocular video, sampling navigation goals (represented as text, image, or spatial waypoints) and generating obstacle-aware trajectories using the constructed geometry. The resulting trajectory distribution is then used to train a flow-matching VLA navigation policy. By using geometry exclusively during training, VEGA distills obstacle-aware planning directly into a vision-based policy. Furthermore, we introduce VEGA-Bench, a benchmark containing 250k scenes and approximately 5 million navigation goals paired with scene geometry, designed to evaluate goal progress, collision avoidance, and obstacle clearance of VLAs. Our evaluation shows that VEGA achieves competitive goal progress while reducing collisions by 33.0% and improving obstacle clearance by 17.9% over the strongest baseline on VEGABench, while improving success by at least 150.0%, reducing collisions by at least 66.7%, and improving obstacle clearance by at least 60.0% in real-world trials. Ultimately, we demonstrate that video-derived geometric supervision provides a scalable and effective signal for training obstacle-aware navigation VLAs. The code and benchmark will be released at the time of publication.
tldr: VEGA trains navigation VLAs from unlabeled egocentric video by reconstructing scene geometry to generate obstacle-aware trajectories, achieving significant improvements in collision avoidance and obstacle clearance in both benchmark and real-world trials.
tldr_zh: VEGA通过从无标注的第一人称视频中重建场景几何来生成避障轨迹，从而训练导航VLA模型，在基准测试和真实环境中显著降低了碰撞率并提升了障碍物通过能力。
summary_zh: 我们提出VEGA——一种利用无标注自我中心导航视频训练导航视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的方法。互联网规模的自我中心视频提供了导航相关视觉观察的可扩展来源，能够捕捉杂乱场景、近距离障碍物以及人类在真实空间中的自然运动。然而，这些视频无法直接用于策略学习，因为它们未能提供基于机器人坐标系中明确导航目标的障碍感知轨迹。VEGA通过从单目视频重建局部场景几何、采样导航目标（以文本、图像或空间路径点的形式表示）并利用重建几何生成障碍感知轨迹来弥补这一差距。所得的轨迹分布随后用于训练流匹配VLA导航策略。通过仅在训练阶段使用几何信息，VEGA将障碍感知规划直接提炼为基于视觉的策略。此外，我们提出VEGA-Bench基准测试，包含25万个场景及约500万个与场景几何配对的导航目标，旨在评估VLA的目标进展、碰撞规避与障碍物清除能力。评估结果表明，在VEGA-Bench上，VEGA在保持竞争性目标进展的同时，碰撞率降低33.0%，障碍物清除能力提升17.9%，优于最强基线；在实际场景测试中，成功率至少提升150.0%，碰撞率至少降低66.7%，障碍物清除能力至少提升60.0%。最终，我们证明视频衍生的几何监督为训练障碍感知导航VLA提供了可扩展且有效的信号。代码与基准测试将在论文发表时开源。

title: PAIWorld: A 3D-Consistent World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation
summary: World foundation models (WFMs) are powerful simulators, yet they predominantly operate in a single-view setting and lack the multi-view 3D consistency required for robotic manipulation. While robotic systems rely on multiple cameras (egocentric, eye-to-hand, and wrist-mounted) for policy learning, current multi-view world models simply concatenate view tokens without explicit geometric reasoning. This causes cross-view object drift, depth inconsistency, and texture misalignment. We trace these failures to two deficiencies: the absence of an explicit inter-view communication mechanism and the lack of a 3D geometric prior. We argue that resolving both simultaneously is necessary and sufficient. To address this, we present PAIWorld, a framework that augments diffusion-transformer world models via three core components: (1) Geometry-Aware Cross-View Attention blocks that establish an explicit pathway across views, (2) Geometric Rotary Position Embedding that encodes camera ray directions and extrinsic poses into the attention mechanism, and (3) Latent 3D-REPA, which distills 3D-aware features from frozen 3D foundation models to ensure 3D consistency. Built upon a DiT-based world foundation model, PAIWorld achieves state-of-the-art multi-view 3D consistency on robotic manipulation benchmarks, ranking 1st on the WorldArena leaderboard and 2nd on the AgiBot-Challenge2026 leaderboard, while enabling downstream applications such as model-based planning, world action models, and multi-view policy post-training.
tldr: PAIWorld augments diffusion-transformer world models with geometry-aware cross-view attention, geometric rotary position encoding, and latent 3D-REPA distillation to achieve multi-view 3D-consistent video prediction for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: PAIWorld 通过几何感知的跨视图注意力、几何旋转位置编码和潜在3D-REPA蒸馏增强扩散变换器世界模型，为机器人操作实现多视图3D一致的视频预测。
summary_zh: 世界基础模型（WFMs）是强大的模拟器，但主要在单视角设置下运行，缺乏机器人操作所需的多视角三维一致性。尽管机器人系统依赖多摄像头（自我中心视角、眼手视角及腕装视角）进行策略学习，当前的多视角世界模型仅简单拼接视角标记，缺乏显式的几何推理。这导致跨视角物体漂移、深度不一致以及纹理错位。我们将这些失败归因于两个缺陷：缺乏显式的视角间通信机制，以及缺少三维几何先验。我们认为同时解决这两个问题既必要又充分。为此，我们提出PAIWorld框架，通过三个核心组件增强扩散变换器世界模型：（1）几何感知跨视角注意力模块，建立跨视角的显式通路；（2）几何旋转变换位置编码，将相机射线方向与外部位姿编码至注意力机制中；（3）潜在三维表征对齐方法，从冻结的三维基础模型中蒸馏三维感知特征以确保三维一致性。基于DiT世界基础模型，PAIWorld在机器人操作基准测试中实现了最先进的多视角三维一致性，在WorldArena排行榜上位列第一，在AgiBot-Challenge2026排行榜上位列第二，同时支持基于模型的规划、世界行动模型及多视角策略后训练等下游应用。

title: A Mixed-Reality Testbed for Autonomous Vehicles
summary: We propose a mixed-reality, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testbed for autonomous vehicles that seamlessly integrates a physical testbed of mobile robots with a high-fidelity simulation environment. The virtual simulation enables the creation of diverse, safety-critical driving scenarios to validate state-of-the-art perception, planning, and control algorithms, while augmenting simulations with physical robots equipped with multimodal sensors in photorealistic virtual environments further facilitating rigorous validation. Our testbed also features vehicular connectivity using wireless communication and can accommodate a large number of agents through the combination of physical robots and virtual simulated agents, supporting research on multi-agent systems including Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs). Finally, we present a safety-guaranteed framework combining perception, planning and a novel online learning-based controller using Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) for CAVs. Experiments using the proposed framework are used to validate and demonstrate the key functionalities and the overall utility of the testbed to bridge the gap between simulation and real-world hardware deployment.
tldr: This paper presents a mixed-reality hardware-in-the-loop testbed that integrates physical mobile robots with high-fidelity simulation to validate autonomous driving algorithms, including a safety-guaranteed controller using Control Barrier Functions.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种混合现实硬件在环测试平台，将物理移动机器人与高保真仿真集成，用于验证自动驾驶算法，包括使用控制屏障函数的安全保证控制器。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种用于自动驾驶汽车的混合现实硬件在环（HIL）测试平台，该平台将移动机器人的物理测试平台与高保真仿真环境无缝集成。虚拟仿真能够创建多样化的、涉及安全关键性的驾驶场景，以验证最先进的感知、规划与控制算法；同时，通过在多光子真实的虚拟环境中搭载多模态传感器的物理机器人来增强仿真，进一步支持严格的验证。我们的测试平台还利用无线通信实现车辆互联，并通过结合物理机器人与虚拟仿真智能体容纳大量代理，从而支持包括智能网联汽车（CAVs）在内的多智能体系统研究。最后，我们提出了一种结合感知、规划及一种基于控制障碍函数（CBFs）的新型在线学习控制器的安全保证框架，用于CAVs。利用所提出框架进行的实验，验证并展示了测试平台的关键功能及其在弥合仿真与真实硬件部署之间差距方面的整体效用。

title: CABLE: Cloud-Assisted Bandwidth-efficient LMM-based Encoding for V2X Systems
summary: Cloud-hosted large multimodal models (LMMs) can provide strong open-vocabulary perception for Vehicle-to-Everything systems, but naively transmitting full-resolution frames from edge to cloud causes severe communication overhead and high cloud-side prefill latency. We present CABLE, a cloud-assisted bandwidth-efficient LMM-based encoding framework for edge-cloud perception. CABLE propagates the previous cloud segmentation mask on the edge using ego-motion compensation, refines it with residual-motion cues, and consolidates disconnected regions via a corridor envelope to form a robust region of interest (ROI). Only ROI-masked images are uploaded, while the cloud segmentation output is fed back as the prior for the next frame, forming a mask-to-ROI-to-LMM feedback loop. Experiments on five datasets (nuScenes, WOD-ZB, Waymo, KITTI, and CADC) show consistent communication savings while largely preserving perception, achieving $73$--$87\%$ ROI pixel-coverage reduction with $5$--$8\times$ estimated LMM prefill speedup at a modest detection-quality trade-off relative to full-frame inference.
tldr: CABLE improves edge-to-cloud V2X perception by propagating cloud segmentation masks on the edge to define a ROI, uploading only masked images, and feeding cloud outputs back as priors, achieving large bandwidth savings and LMM prefill speedup with minimal detection loss.
tldr_zh: CABLE通过将云端分割掩码在边缘传播以定义感兴趣区域（ROI）、仅上传掩码图像并将云端输出反馈为下一帧先验，大幅节省V2X感知中的通信带宽并加速LMM预填充，同时检测性能损失很小。
summary_zh: 云托管的大规模多模态模型为车联万物系统提供了强大的开放词汇感知能力，但将全分辨率帧从边缘端直接传输至云端会带来严重的通信开销和较高的云端预填充延迟。我们提出CABLE——一种面向边缘-云端感知的、基于大规模多模态模型的带宽高效编码框架。CABLE利用自运动补偿在边缘端传播先前的云端分割掩码，通过残差运动线索进行优化，并采用通道包络方法整合不连续区域，形成鲁棒的感兴趣区域。仅上传经感兴趣区域掩码处理的图像，同时将云端分割输出作为下一帧的先验信息反馈，构成“掩码→感兴趣区域→大规模多模态模型”的闭环。在五个数据集（nuScenes、WOD-ZB、Waymo、KITTI和CADC）上的实验表明，该方法在基本保持感知性能的同时持续降低通信量，实现73%-87%的感兴趣区域像素覆盖率缩减，预估大规模多模态模型预填充速度提升5-8倍，且相对于全帧推理仅有适度的检测质量折衷。

title: OneCanvas: 3D Scene Understanding via Panoramic Reprojection
summary: Existing approaches to 3D scene understanding in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) either rely on complex, model-specific geometry encoders or large training budgets in pursuit of spatial reasoning. Instead, OneCanvas aggregates patch features from all views onto a single equirectangular panoramic canvas. Namely, each patch is unprojected to a 3D world coordinate using its depth and camera pose, then placed on the canvas at the continuous longitude and latitude of that point as seen from the canvas origin, with no rasterization or aggregation across overlapping views. A 3D position embedding of the patch's metric coordinates is added to its feature, restoring the depth lost when collapsing the world position to an angular canvas coordinate. Patches from all frames thus share one spatial coordinate system with no fusion or major architectural modifications of the backbone. The pretrained VLM consumes this representation as if it were an ordinary image. Because the canvas can be centered on any pose of interest, the same representation directly supports situated reasoning from a specific viewpoint, a common requirement in robotics and embodied AI. Thanks to this representation, we can also introduce a spatial pretraining curriculum: by procedurally placing patch features of objects, drawn from real images, at chosen 3D world positions on an otherwise empty canvas, we generate on-the-fly supervision spanning a broad range of spatial reasoning tasks, with answer distributions controlled to reduce spatial reasoning shortcuts. OneCanvas achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on SQA3D and VSI-Bench, and generalizes to out-of-distribution data on SPBench, using an order of magnitude less training compute than the strongest competing methods.
tldr: OneCanvas projects multi-view patch features onto a single panoramic canvas with 3D position embeddings, enabling a pretrained VLM to perform 3D scene understanding without complex architectural changes, and achieves SOTA on spatial reasoning benchmarks with lower training compute.
tldr_zh: OneCanvas 将多视图的补丁特征投影到单一全景画布上，并添加 3D 位置编码，使预训练的 VLM 无需复杂架构修改即可进行 3D 场景理解，在空间推理基准上以更少的训练计算达到 SOTA。
summary_zh: 现有视觉-语言模型（VLM）中的三维场景理解方法，要么依赖复杂的、模型专用的几何编码器，要么为追求空间推理能力而投入大量训练预算。与之不同，OneCanvas将所有视角的图像块特征聚合到单一等距柱面全景画布上。具体来说，每个图像块利用其深度和相机姿态被反投影到三维世界坐标中，然后以该点相对于画布原点的连续经纬度坐标放置在画布上，过程中无需进行光栅化或跨重叠视图的聚合操作。图像块度量坐标的三维位置嵌入被添加到其特征中，从而恢复将世界位置压缩为角度画布坐标时丢失的深度信息。因此，所有帧的图像块共享一个空间坐标系，无需对主干网络进行融合或重大架构修改。预训练的VLM可像处理普通图像一样消费这一表征。由于画布可以以任意感兴趣的姿态为中心，同一表征可直接支持从特定视角进行情景推理，这是机器人和具身智能领域的常见需求。借助这种表征，我们还可以引入空间预训练课程：通过将真实图像中提取的物体图像块特征，以程序化方式放置在空白画布上选定的三维世界位置，我们能够实时生成覆盖广泛空间推理任务的监督信号，并通过控制答案分布来减少空间推理捷径。OneCanvas在SQA3D和VSI-Bench上达到了最先进的准确率，并能泛化至SPBench上的分布外数据，而训练计算量比最强竞争方法低一个数量级。

title: Mobile Pedipulation for Object Sliding via Hierarchical Control on a Wheeled Bipedal Robot
summary: In this letter, we present a hierarchical control framework that enables wheeled bipedal robots to perform planar object sliding tasks with their wheeled legs. The proposed approach formulates a nonlinear model predictive controller (NMPC) based on a reduced-order three rigid bodies (TRB) dynamical model that explicitly accounts for the hip roll degree of freedom and multiple wheel-environment contact modes, which is essential for lateral stepping and pedipulation tasks. Within this framework, the NMPC simultaneously regulates robot locomotion and interaction forces, allowing the robot to stably execute both rolling and object manipulation behaviors. A trajectory-optimization-based robot-object motion planner is developed to generate reference motions that incorporate stick-slip transitions in ground-object contact. Two representative pedipulation motions, namely scooting and lateral sliding, are validated through real-world hardware experiments, in which the robot successfully retrieves a 1 kg object from under a desk and slides a 4 kg object over a distance of 0.228 m via scooting.
tldr: A hierarchical control framework enabling wheeled bipedal robots to perform planar object sliding (pedipulation) using a reduced-order model NMPC and trajectory optimization, validated on real hardware.
tldr_zh: 提出一种分层控制框架，使轮式双足机器人能够通过简化模型NMPC和轨迹优化实现平面物体滑动（足部操作），并在真实硬件上验证。
summary_zh: 在本研究中，我们提出了一种分层控制框架，使轮式双足机器人能够利用其轮式腿执行平面物体滑动任务。所提出的方法构建了一个基于三刚体（TRB）降阶动力学模型的非线性模型预测控制器（NMPC），该模型显式考虑了髋关节侧摆自由度及多种轮地接触模式，这对于侧向跨步和腿部操控任务至关重要。在该框架下，NMPC同时调节机器人 locomotion 与交互力，使机器人能够稳定执行滚动和物体操控行为。我们开发了一种基于轨迹优化的机器人-物体运动规划器，能够生成包含地面-物体接触中粘滑过渡的参考运动。通过实物硬件实验验证了两种代表性的腿部操控动作——侧滑与平移滑动，实验中机器人成功从桌底取出1千克物体，并通过平移滑动将4千克物体推移0.228米。

title: FAST-LIVGO: A Degeneracy-Robust LiDAR-Inertial-Visual-GNSS Fusion Odometry
summary: Robust state estimation and mapping in long-term, large-scale, and highly dynamic environments remains a key challenge in robotics. Existing LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry (LIVO) systems achieve strong local accuracy but suffer from accumulated drift over long distances and may fail in geometrically degraded or textureless scenes. Meanwhile, GNSS-aided fusion frameworks often rely on LiDAR or visual odometry for state prediction and outlier rejection, making them vulnerable when odometry degenerates. To address these limitations, we propose a tightly coupled LiDAR-Inertial-Visual-GNSS fusion framework based on an Error-State Iterated Kalman Filter. An online spatiotemporal alignment module using Dynamic Time Warping is introduced for highly dynamic conditions. To better exploit GNSS precision, we develop observation models based on Doppler shifts and fixed-anchor Time-Differenced Carrier Phase, providing millimeter-level relative constraints without augmenting historical anchor states. We further design a degeneracy-aware dual-mode outlier rejection strategy that switches between LIVO-prior-guided rejection and GNSS-aided recovery according to the LIVO degeneracy level. Experiments on the public M3DGR dataset and a custom 20~m/s fixed-wing UAV dataset demonstrate that our system reduces accumulated drift and map ghosting, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in accuracy and robustness.
tldr: A tightly coupled LiDAR-Inertial-Visual-GNSS fusion odometry framework that uses a degeneracy-aware dual-mode outlier rejection and Doppler/TDCP-based GNSS models to reduce drift in long-range, dynamic environments.
tldr_zh: 一种基于误差状态迭代卡尔曼滤波的紧耦合 LiDAR-惯性-视觉-GNSS 融合里程计框架，通过退化感知双模式异常值抑制和基于多普勒/时差载波相位的 GNSS 观测模型，减少长距离、动态环境中的漂移和地图重影。
summary_zh: 鲁棒的状态估计与建图在长期、大规模且高度动态的环境中仍是机器人领域的关键挑战。现有的激光-惯性-视觉里程计系统虽能实现较高的局部精度，但在长距离运行中会产生累积漂移，并可能在几何退化或无纹理场景中失效。与此同时，GNSS辅助的融合框架通常依赖激光或视觉里程计进行状态预测与异常值剔除，当里程计退化时容易失效。为解决上述局限，我们提出一种基于误差状态迭代卡尔曼滤波的紧耦合激光-惯性-视觉-GNSS融合框架。针对高度动态条件，引入基于动态时间规整的在线时空对齐模块。为更充分利用GNSS精度，我们基于多普勒频移和固定锚点时间差分载波相位建立观测模型，在无需扩充历史锚点状态的前提下提供毫米级相对约束。进一步设计了一种退化感知的双模式异常值剔除策略，根据激光-惯性-视觉里程计退化程度，在优先引导剔除与GNSS辅助恢复模式间切换。在公共M3DGR数据集及自研20米/秒固定翼无人机数据集上的实验表明，本系统有效降低了累积漂移与地图重影，在精度与鲁棒性上均超越现有最优方法。

title: FlexLAM: Resolving the Bottleneck Trade-off in Latent Action Learning
summary: Latent actions provide a compact interface between action-free video and downstream decision-making, yet existing Latent Action Models (LAMs) force every transition through a fixed-capacity bottleneck. We identify a bottleneck trade-off: overly tight codes can discard transition cues needed for action alignment, while overly loose codes preserve additional transition variation that must be resolved when alignment labels are scarce or narrowly distributed. FlexLAM replaces this fixed capacity with variable-length latent actions trained by nested dropout, yielding prefix-valid codes that capture compact transition structure first and add detail only when needed, without new architectures or losses. A single FlexLAM matches or surpasses separately trained fixed-capacity LAMs at every evaluated token budget under standard scarce-label supervision and under a low-return single-task alignment stress test, indicating that FlexLAM is not merely adjustable at inference time but learns a better latent-action interface at the same token budgets. The same model supports inference-time token-budget adjustment without retraining, and FlexLAM improves Ego4D transition reconstruction. These results suggest that variable-length latent actions are an architecture-free, drop-in upgrade to the fixed-capacity bottleneck in latent action models, latent-action world models, and video-pretrained action interfaces.
tldr: FlexLAM replaces fixed-capacity latent action bottlenecks with variable-length codes via nested dropout, resolving a trade-off between discarding and preserving transition details and improving transition reconstruction and alignment under scarce labels.
tldr_zh: FlexLAM通过嵌套dropout用可变长度潜变量代码替代固定容量的潜动作瓶颈，解决了丢弃或保留过渡细节之间的权衡，在标签稀缺下改进了过渡重建和对齐。
summary_zh: 潜在动作为无动作视频与下游决策之间提供了紧凑的接口，然而现有的潜在动作模型（LAMs）强制要求每一次转换都需经过固定容量的瓶颈。我们发现了一个瓶颈权衡问题：过于紧凑的编码会丢弃动作对齐所需的转换线索，而过于宽松的编码则会保留额外的转换变异，当对齐标签稀缺或分布狭窄时，这些变异必须被解析。FlexLAM通过嵌套丢弃法训练的变长潜在动作取代了这种固定容量，生成了前缀有效的编码，这些编码首先捕获紧凑的转换结构，仅在必要时添加细节，而无需引入新架构或损失函数。在标准的稀疏标签监督下以及在低回报单任务对齐压力测试中，单个FlexLAM在每一个评估的令牌预算下，均能达到或超越分别训练的固定容量LAMs的性能。这表明FlexLAM不仅能在推理时调整，还能在相同令牌预算下学习到更好的潜在动作接口。同一模型支持推理时无需重新训练的令牌预算调整，并且FlexLAM改进了Ego4D转换重建效果。这些结果表明，变长潜在动作是对潜在动作模型、潜在动作世界模型及视频预训练动作接口中固定容量瓶颈的一种无需架构调整、即插即用的升级方案。

title: Monocular 3D Occupancy Perception for Robots on Sidewalks via Hybrid 2D-3D Learning
summary: Sidewalks in the real world are crowded, cluttered, and less structured than roads, making 3D occupancy prediction a key ingredient for the safe navigation of mobile robots such as delivery bots and electric wheelchairs. Existing occupancy learning pipelines are largely designed for on-road autonomous driving and often train on large-scale paired LiDAR-RGB datasets with dense 3D supervision and multiple camera inputs, which are costly to collect and do not adequately capture sidewalk-specific characteristics. We propose WalkOCC, a hybrid Ray-marching monocular 3D occupancy perception framework for robots operating on sidewalks. WalkOCC explicitly couples geometric grounding from LiDAR-RGB paired data with scalable learning from large-scale unpaired monocular images. It bootstraps pseudo occupancy supervision from paired sequences and jointly learns image-level representations on additional 2D-only data. It yields stable optimization and improved generalization without requiring costly 3D occupancy annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent gains in prediction accuracy, fine-grained segmentation of subtle urban structures such as curbs and gutters, and robustness to environmental and cross-embodiment shifts compared with self-supervised image-based baselines. To facilitate evaluation and benchmarking, we also introduce Sidewalk3D, a large-scale sidewalk perception dataset with LiDAR-camera paired sequences collected across multiple locations and time periods, along with 3D semantic occupancy annotations for evaluation. Code and data will be made available.
tldr: A monocular 3D occupancy perception framework for sidewalk robots, using hybrid 2D-3D learning to combine LiDAR-RGB geometric grounding with scalable unpaired image learning, and introducing the Sidewalk3D dataset.
tldr_zh: 一个针对人行道机器人的单目3D占据感知框架，通过混合2D-3D学习结合激光雷达-RGB几何信息与可扩展的无配对图像学习，并引入了Sidewalk3D数据集。
summary_zh: 现实世界中的人行道拥挤、杂乱且结构不如道路规整，这使得三维占用预测成为送餐机器人、电动轮椅等移动机器人安全导航的关键要素。现有的占用学习管线主要面向道路自动驾驶场景设计，通常依赖大规模配准的激光雷达-RGB数据集进行训练，需要密集的三维监督信号和多摄像头输入，成本高昂且难以充分捕捉人行道的独特特征。我们提出WalkOCC——一种面向人行道作业机器人的混合式射线追踪单目三维占用感知框架。该框架通过显式耦合激光雷达-RGB配对数据中的几何先验与大尺度非配对单目图像的可扩展学习能力，利用配对序列引导生成伪占用监督信号，并在额外纯二维数据上联合学习图像级表征。该方法在无需昂贵三维占用标注的情况下实现了稳定优化与泛化性能提升。大量实验表明，与基于自监督图像的基准方法相比，本方法在预测精度、路缘/排水沟等细微城市结构的细粒度分割以及环境与跨形态场景变化的鲁棒性方面均取得持续改进。为便于评估与基准测试，我们还发布了Sidewalk3D——涵盖多时段多地点采集的激光雷达-相机配对序列的大规模人行道感知数据集，并附带用于评估的三维语义占用标注。代码与数据将开源。

title: GCNGrasp-VP: Affordance-Guided View Planning for Efficient Task-Oriented Grasping
summary: Task-oriented grasping performance degrades significantly when object views suffer from occlusions. Existing task-oriented grasping methods typically assume task-relevant regions are visible in the initial frame, while view planning approaches enable active perception but often ignore task semantics and rely on time-consuming scene reconstruction. To address these limitations, we present GCNGrasp-VP, an efficient framework integrating affordance field prediction with active view planning. Central to this framework is GCNGrasp-v2, a task-oriented grasp model that simultaneously supports grasp evaluation and affordance field prediction, achieving constant-time inference complexity. Leveraging this capability, our Affordance-guided View Planner (Affordance-VP) utilizes the affordance field as an information gain metric to guide camera observation of task-relevant regions without requiring scene reconstruction. View planning results show that our method significantly outperforms scene-uncertainty-driven baselines with only one view adjustment. Real-world validation further confirms substantial improvements in grasp success rates for single-object scenarios while maintaining millisecond-level computational latency. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Instinct323/GCNGrasp-VP.
tldr: GCNGrasp-VP integrates affordance field prediction into active view planning for task-oriented grasping, enabling efficient occlusion handling without scene reconstruction and achieving millisecond-level latency.
tldr_zh: GCNGrasp-VP 将可供性场预测集成到主动视角规划中，无需场景重建即可高效处理遮挡问题，实现毫秒级延迟并获得抓取成功率提升。
summary_zh: 面向任务的抓取性能在目标视角存在遮挡时会显著下降。现有面向任务的抓取方法通常假设初始视角中任务相关区域可见，而视角规划方法虽能实现主动感知，却往往忽略任务语义并依赖耗时场景重建。为解决上述局限，我们提出GCNGrasp-VP——一种将可供性场预测与主动视角规划相结合的高效框架。该框架的核心是GCNGrasp-v2，一种同时支持抓取评估与可供性场预测的面向任务抓取模型，实现了恒定时间推理复杂度。基于此能力，我们提出的可供性引导视角规划器（Affordance-VP）将可供性场作为信息增益度量指标，无需场景重建即可引导相机观测任务相关区域。视角规划结果表明，本方法仅通过单次视角调整即显著优于基于场景不确定性的基线方法。实际场景验证进一步证实，该方法能在维持毫秒级计算延时的同时，大幅提升单物体场景的抓取成功率。代码与模型已开源至https://github.com/Instinct323/GCNGrasp-VP。

title: ART-VS: Adaptive Resolution Tiling for Vision Transformer Visual Servoing
summary: Visual servoing with self-supervised Vision Transformer (ViT) features enables training-free robotic positioning with strong generalization, but faces a fundamental trade-off between robustness and precision. Coarse patch-level descriptors provide stable correspondences yet limit positioning accuracy. Increasing image resolution improves precision but yields only marginal robustness gains - under perturbation, high-resolution processing improves convergence success rate from 76.6% to just 81.0% despite 12x more ViT patches. Therefore, we propose Adaptive Resolution Tiling Visual Servoing (ART-VS), a two-phase method that adapts feature granularity to servoing progress: a coarse phase at native ViT resolution for stable alignment, then a tiled high-resolution phase that restricts matching to local neighborhoods improving positioning accuracy. Without any task-specific training, ART-VS achieves 95.4% convergence under perturbation, outperforming standard and full-resolution ViT-based servoing by 18.8 and 14.4 percentage points. Over the former it reduces positioning error by 53%, while running at over 10x higher speed and 27% lower VRAM than the latter. We validate ART-VS across three ViT backbones and demonstrate real-world category-level grasping of unseen object instances, achieving 95/100 on transparent bottles and 98/100 on shoes. Code available under https://art-vs.github.io/.
tldr: ART-VS proposes an adaptive resolution tiling method for Vision Transformer visual servoing that improves both robustness and precision by switching from coarse to high-resolution tiled patches during alignment, achieving superior convergence and speed without task-specific training.
tldr_zh: ART-VS 提出了一种自适应分辨率分块方法，用于 Vision Transformer 视觉伺服，通过在对齐过程中从粗粒度切换到高分辨率分块补丁，在无需特定任务训练的情况下实现了更优的收敛性和速度。
summary_zh: 采用自监督视觉Transformer（ViT）特征的视觉伺服方法，无需训练即可实现强泛化能力的机器人定位，但面临鲁棒性与精度之间的根本性权衡。粗粒度图像块级描述符能提供稳定对应关系，却限制了定位精度。提升图像分辨率可改善精度，但仅带来微弱的鲁棒性增益——在扰动条件下，尽管ViT图像块数量增加12倍，高分辨率处理仅将收敛成功率从76.6%提升至81.0%。为此，我们提出自适应分辨率分块视觉伺服（ART-VS）方法，该两阶段方案根据伺服进程自适应调整特征粒度：首先在原始ViT分辨率下进行粗粒度阶段实现稳定对齐，随后转入分块高分辨率阶段，将匹配限制在局部邻域内以提升定位精度。无需任何任务特定训练，ART-VS在扰动条件下达到95.4%的收敛率，较标准分辨率和全分辨率ViT伺服方法分别提升18.8和14.4个百分点。与前者相比，定位误差降低53%，同时以后者10倍以上的速度和27%更低的显存消耗运行。我们在三种ViT骨干网络上验证了ART-VS性能，并在真实场景中实现了未见物体实例的类别级抓取：透明瓶装物95/100成功率，鞋类98/100成功率。代码发布于https://art-vs.github.io/。

title: Sensor Configuration Matters: A Systematic Evaluation of Multimodal SLAM on Quadruped Robots
summary: Autonomous navigation of quadrupedal robots in diverse environments fundamentally relies on resilient Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). While visual-inertial SLAM has matured across wheeled, handheld, and aerial platforms, a critical evaluation gap remains regarding how hardware-level sensor configurations affect performance under the aggressive dynamics of legged locomotion. Quadrupeds introduce distinct embodiment-induced sensory challenges, including foot-impact shocks, high-frequency mechanical vibrations, and rapid angular rotations, which degrade standard perception pipelines. To address this gap, we present a systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art visual, visual-inertial, and LiDAR-visual-inertial SLAM methods using the GrandTour dataset recorded on an ANYmal D quadruped. We isolate and quantify the impacts of camera modalities, shutter techniques, and inertial sensor tiers, analyzing their trade-offs across localization accuracy, algorithmic robustness, and computational resource utilization. Our empirical findings demonstrate that hardware selection has substantial influence on system resilience: stereo configurations consistently outperform monocular and RGB-D modalities, global shutter cameras significantly mitigate motion-induced tracking failures compared to rolling shutter cameras, and, crucially, standard inertial integration can degrade the performance of primarily vision-based frameworks under harsh legged locomotion. These insights additionally offer concrete design guidelines for tailoring custom sensor payloads to achieve dependable perception on agile legged systems.
tldr: Empirical evaluation of how sensor configuration (camera type, shutter, inertial tier) affects SLAM performance on a quadruped robot under legged locomotion dynamics.
tldr_zh: 系统评估了传感器配置（相机类型、快门、惯性层级）对四足机器人SLAM在腿部运动动态下性能的影响。
summary_zh: 四足机器人在复杂环境中的自主导航根本上有赖于鲁棒的同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）。虽然视觉-惯性SLAM已在轮式、手持和空中平台上趋于成熟，但在足式运动剧烈动力学条件下，硬件级传感器配置如何影响性能仍存在关键评估空白。四足机器人会带来独特的具身感知挑战，包括足部冲击、高频机械振动和快速角运动，这些都会降低标准感知流程的性能。为填补这一空白，我们利用在ANYmal D型四足机器人上采集的GrandTour数据集，对当前先进的视觉、视觉-惯性及激光雷达-视觉-惯性SLAM方法进行了系统性评估。我们分离并量化了相机模态、快门类型和惯性传感器等级的影响，分析了它们在定位精度、算法鲁棒性和计算资源利用之间的权衡。实验结果表明，硬件选择对系统鲁棒性具有显著影响：立体配置持续优于单目和RGB-D模态；相较于卷帘快门相机，全局快门相机能显著减少运动导致的跟踪失败；尤为关键的是，在剧烈的足式运动下，标准惯性融合反而可能降低以视觉为主的框架的性能。这些发现还为定制传感器载荷提供了具体设计指导，以实现敏捷足式系统的可靠感知。

title: DiffusionVS: A Generative Framework for Robust Visual Servoing Based on Diffusion Policy
summary:
Visual servoing is a fundamental technique in robotic manipulation and navigation. Regression-based visual servoing frequently experiences trajectory jitter as a result of noise-sensitive single-step mappings and the accumulation of errors during distribution shifts. In contrast, Diffusion Policy maintains temporal consistency by predicting action sequences and improves robustness through implicit data augmentation.
  This paper presents a novel diffusion-based servoing method. Based on Diffusion Policy, the proposed approach uses normalized image coordinates of observed tag corners as input and generates camera velocity through conditional denoising. To overcome the generalization limitations of models trained on static datasets, an online training paradigm is adopted, continuously expanding the diversity of training data through interactive experience collection. This strategy substantially enhances both the performance and generalization capability of the model. Comprehensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, achieving success rates of nearly 100\% in simulation and 93\% in physical experiments. Beyond the specific pipeline, we further validate the generality of the diffusion mechanism. Experiments show that existing visual servoing networks consistently achieve improved performance when integrated with our diffusion-based module. These results indicate that the proposed strategy possesses broad applicability and can enhance various visual servoing systems beyond the specific architecture presented here.
tldr: This paper introduces a diffusion policy-based visual servoing framework that uses conditional denoising to generate smooth camera velocity commands, overcoming trajectory jitter and generalization issues via online training, achieving high success in both simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于扩散策略的视觉伺服框架，通过条件去噪生成平滑的相机速度指令，并利用在线训练克服轨迹抖动和泛化问题，在仿真和真实实验中均取得了高成功率。
summary_zh:
视觉伺服是机器人操作与导航中的一项基础技术。基于回归的视觉伺服方法常因噪声敏感的单步映射以及分布偏移中的误差累积而出现轨迹抖动。相比之下，扩散策略通过预测动作序列保持时间一致性，并利用隐式数据增强提升鲁棒性。

本文提出了一种新颖的基于扩散的伺服方法。该方法以扩散策略为基础，将观测到的标签角点的归一化图像坐标作为输入，通过条件去噪生成相机速度。为克服基于静态数据集训练的模型在泛化能力上的局限，本文采用了在线训练范式，通过交互式经验采集持续扩展训练数据的多样性。该策略显著提升了模型的性能与泛化能力。全面的仿真及真实世界实验验证了所提方法的有效性，在仿真中实现了近100%的成功率，在物理实验中实现了93%的成功率。除了具体的流程之外，本文进一步验证了扩散机制的通用性。实验表明，当集成基于扩散的模块时，现有视觉伺服网络的性能均得到一致提升。这些结果表明，所提策略具备广泛的适用性，能够超越本文所呈现的具体架构，增强多种视觉伺服系统。

title: Generating Natural and Expressive Robot Gestures through Iterative Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback using LLMs
summary: Expressive gestures are essential for natural and effective communication, complementing speech when verbal cues alone are insufficient (e.g., pointing). For social robots such as the humanoid Pepper, producing natural and expressive movements is critical for improving human-robot interaction (HRI) and long-term acceptance. However, generating gestures remains challenging due to reliance on expert-authored animations, resulting in rigid behaviors that are impractical for dynamic and diverse environments. Alternatively, machine learning approaches often struggle to capture perceived naturalness, becoming increasingly challenging with more degrees of freedom. Consequently, producing expressive robot gestures requires a system that can adapt to the environment while adhering to social norms and physical constraints. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) enable dynamic code generation, offering new opportunities for runtime gesture synthesis from natural language. In this paper, we integrate ChatGPT into the humanoid robot Pepper to generate co-speech gestures aligned with conversational output. While this baseline enables flexible gesture generation, the resulting motions are often perceived as stiff and unnatural. To address this limitation, we introduce an iterative reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF) system that finetunes gesture generation based on user evaluations, leveraging an iterative user study to compare Pepper's generated gestures. Our results show that RLHF improved the LLM's co-speech generative capabilities, producing more expressive, relevant and fluid movements.
tldr: This paper uses LLMs and iterative reinforcement learning with human feedback to generate natural, expressive co-speech gestures on a humanoid robot (Pepper), addressing the stiffness of baseline LLM-generated motions.
tldr_zh: 本文利用大语言模型和迭代式人类反馈强化学习，在类人机器人Pepper上生成自然、富有表现力的共语手势，改善了基线LLM生成动作的僵硬问题。
summary_zh: 表达性手势对于自然且有效的沟通至关重要，能在仅靠言语提示不足时（例如指向动作）补充语言。对于像人形机器人Pepper这样的社交机器人而言，产生自然且富有表现力的动作，对于改善人机交互及长期接受度至关重要。然而，由于依赖专家编写的动画，生成手势仍具挑战性，这导致机器人行为僵化，难以适应动态多样的环境。另一方面，机器学习方法往往难以捕捉人类感知的自然性，且随着自由度的增加，挑战也愈发艰巨。因此，生成富有表现力的机器人手势需要一个既能适应环境，又能遵循社会规范与物理约束的系统。大语言模型的最新进展实现了动态代码生成，为根据自然语言实时合成手势带来了新机遇。本文中，我们将ChatGPT集成到人形机器人Pepper中，以生成与对话输出相一致的伴随语言手势。尽管这一基线方案实现了灵活的手势生成，但生成的动作往往被感知为生硬且不自然。为解决这一局限，我们引入了一种基于人类反馈的迭代强化学习系统，根据用户评价对手势生成进行微调，并通过迭代用户研究比较Pepper生成的手势。结果表明，RLHF提升了大语言模型在伴随语言手势生成方面的能力，产生了更具表现力、相关性更强且更流畅的动作。

title: Stealthy World Model Manipulation via Data Poisoning
summary: Model-based learning agents use learned world models to predict future states, plan actions, and adapt to new environments.
